body_markdown:
Continued orders from leading drone company reflect an ongoing collaboration and continued demand for Maris-Tech’s advanced video technology


Rehovot, Israel, Nov. 10, 2026 — Maris-Tech Ltd. (Nasdaq: MTEK, MTEKW) (“Maris-Tech” or the “Company”), a global leader in edge computing, artificial intelligence (“AI”), and video intelligence solutions for defense applications, today announced that it has received a $350,000 follow-on order from Aero Sentinel, a leading company in the drone sector, for its Uranus Drones platform. Deliveries under the order are scheduled for 2027 and 2028.


The new order builds on a long-standing commercial relationship between Maris-Tech and Aero Sentinel, which has placed multiple orders for Maris-Tech technology over the years. The Company believes that the repeat business reflects Aero Sentinel’s continued confidence in Maris-Tech’s products and their suitability for demanding drone applications.


Maris-Tech’s Uranus Drones platform is designed to provide advanced video processing capabilities for unmanned aerial vehicles (“UAVs”), enabling the integration and processing of multiple video streams within compact, power-efficient systems. Optimized for the size, weight, and power constraints of drone platforms, the technology is intended to support real-time video applications in demanding operational environments.


“We are pleased to receive another order from Aero Sentinel, a customer with whom we have worked closely for many years,” said Israel Bar, Chief Executive Officer of Maris-Tech. “Repeat orders are particularly meaningful to us because we believe that they reflect customers’ experiences with our technology over time. We value Aero Sentinel’s continued trust, and we look forward to supporting its future drone programs.”


“Our relationship with Maris-Tech is built on mutual trust, technical cooperation, and a shared commitment to delivering reliable solutions,” said Israel Vaserlauf, Chief Executive Officer of Aero Sentinel. “We value Maris-Tech not only for the quality of its technology and products, but also for the professionalism and responsiveness of its team. As our requirements have evolved, Maris-Tech has remained a trusted technology partner, and we appreciate the strong relationship we have built together.”


**About Maris-Tech Ltd.**


Maris-Tech delivers AI-powered edge video solutions for mission-critical defense and security operations, enabling real-time situational awareness, intelligence gathering, and surveillance in bandwidth- and latency-constrained environments. Trusted by leading security organizations, Maris-Tech platforms are deployed across UAVs, UGVs, armored vehicles, and dismounted soldier systems, supporting missions that require ultra-low-latency video processing and onboard AI analytics. From intelligence collection in extreme conditions to AI-driven surveillance and terrain dominance, Maris-Tech masters the AI video pipeline at the edge through best-in-class SWaP-optimized, ruggedized computing solutions.


For more information, visit https://www.maris-tech.com/
